stem.text: In an experiment, a stationary wave is formed on a string stretched horizontally between two fixed points.
Which statement about the experiment is correct?

A.text: At certain times, the string between two nodes is horizontal with all points having zero displacement.

B.text: Each point on the string between two antinodes has an oscillation of the same amplitude.

C.text: The number of nodes is equal to the number of antinodes.

D.text: Two adjacent antinodes oscillate in phase.
